issuer.description: An open-source community project to digitalize results from physics into Lean 4. Physlib Contributions records signed awards for reviewing, maintenance, refactoring and foundational work on Physlib.

review.appointment: Maintainers are appointed and removed by agreement of the existing maintainers, discussed openly on the Physlib Zulip channel. Any maintainer may step down at any time.
